description: This file manages device identity operations including key generation, loading/saving identity data, signing payloads, and verifying signatures, specifically for device identity management using Ed25519 keys.

methods.name: resolveDefaultIdentityPath
methods.description: Returns the default file path for storing device identity JSON.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Ensures that the directory for a given file path exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: generateIdentity
methods.description: Generates a new Ed25519 key pair and creates a device identity object with a fingerprint-based device ID.
